test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: You are shocked to see how waste is littered in your society and no one is bothered. As a result, kids of the society fall sick very often. As a science student, how would you react to the situation ?

options.text: Explain the importance of waste management to all residents, start segregation of waste and start composting
Shout at the staff for not taking care
Turn a blind eye to the situation

solution:
The correct answer is __**Explain the importance of waste management to all residents, start segregation of waste and start composting.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• As a** science student**, it is important to understand the impact of waste on the environment and human health.
 
• Here are **some ways **to react to the situation:
 
• **Educate the residents**:
 
 
• Explain the** importance of waste management **and its impact on the environment and human health.
 
• Encourage them to** start segregation **of waste and composting.
 
 
 
• **Lead by example**:
 
 
• Start segregating waste and composting in your **own house** and encourage others to do the same.
 
• This will help to** reduce** the amount of waste generated and promote a cleaner environment.
 
 
 
• **Collaborate with local authorities:**
 
 
• Reach out to** local authorities and NGOs** working on waste management to understand the existing waste management system in the area and suggest ways to improve it.
 
 
 
• **Organize awareness campaigns:**
 
 
• Organize awareness campaigns in the** society to educate people** about the importance of waste management.
 
• Use **posters, videos, **and other creative ways to spread the message.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Waste management r**efers to the process of collecting, transporting, processing, recycling, and disposing of waste materials.
 
• It is important to manage waste properly to** reduce the impact** on the environment and human health.
 
• Effective waste management involves reducing the amount of waste generated**, reusing and recycling** materials, and** disposing of waste** in a safe and sustainable manner.
